name: systeme.io
one_liner: systeme.io is an all-in-one funnel builder and marketing platform (funnels, email campaigns, courses, ecommerce) offering a self-serve REST API and an official MCP server.

evidence.quote: attach your API key to the X-API-Key header of each request
the free plan never expires and does not require a credit card
Give your key a name, set an expiration date, and click Save
This is an initial release implementation and does not yet support the recommended authentication method (OAuth).
Contact - Create, retrieve, update, delete, and list
API calls from a server-side environment

Unauthenticated probe -> HTTP 401; WWW-Authenticate: None; body: {"type":"https:\/\/tools.ietf.org\/html\/rfc2616#section-10","title":"An error occurred","detail":"Full authentication is required to access this resource."}
MCP initialize POST -> HTTP 401 (text/html; charset=UTF-8); endpoint is live

notes: Public REST API (developer.systeme.io/reference, ~40 resources x CRUD = roughly 100-150 endpoints, so medium breadth) authenticated via X-API-Key header; keys are self-generated in dashboard Settings > MCP & API keys with no approval step, and the free plan (no credit card required) includes API/MCP key generation. Separately, systeme.io ships an official MCP server (mcp.systeme.io/mcp) authenticated with a key-based scheme (OAuth explicitly not yet supported per their docs), covering contacts, tags, and newsletters. No OAuth2/JWT/basic documented for the public API — key-only auth today.
